Actus reus
- Has an article with a blade or point in a public place without good reason.

Mens rea
- Intentionally or recklessly having the article.

Common defences
- Good reason or lawful authority.

Sentencing
- Triable either way. In the magistrates' court the maximum custodial sentence is up to 6 months; on indictment up to 4 years (Criminal Justice Act 1988 s.139).
